item.title: Building a system of context for agentic AI
item.description: The “Age of Intelligence” has arrived, and enterprise ambitions are rising with it. Many organizations have moved beyond experimenting with generative AI chatbots and are targeting agentic AI: systems that can reason, decide, and execute multi-step work with limited human intervention. But there’s a hard truth behind the hype: autonomy is only as reliable as the data an agent can access and trust. item.title: IBM proposes unified architecture for hybrid quantum-classical computing
item.description: Quantum computing has moved past the “science curiosity” stage, but, ultimately, hasn’t reached the general-purpose, fault-tolerant phase. This, researchers say, requires the use of quantum computers and classic high performance computing (HPC) in tandem. When combined, they can process emerging algorithms and workflows, and truly scale real-world applications. To this end, IBM has released what it calls the industry’s first published quantum‑centric supercomputing (QCSC) reference architecture.

item.title: 엔터프라이즈 AI 시장을 흔드는 최강 AI 업체 10곳
item.description: AI는 최전선의 엔터프라이즈를 빠르게 바꾸고 있다. CIO의 AI 비전을 현실로 만드는 데 힘을 보태는 순수 AI 기업, 하이퍼스케일러, 하드웨어 제조사, 소프트웨어 업체, 컨설팅 기업 가운데 가장 강력한 10곳을 정리했다. item.title: IA en salud: la tecnología al servicio del bien común

item.title: 오라클, AI 도입에 맞춰 개발 인력 감축
